area: Cleave and the standard element ladder's I3 crystals
summary: Cleave lays its I3/I4 team Space crystals inside the arena (I3: the cage's heart, behind all three rinds) instead of the platform scatter, which put 58% of them outside the 720 arena; its AI turns for its team's crystal on one strike in three
why: Yash's voyage-ready pass on the Swordfish: the Space crystal should be earned by cutting to it. Compiled outside the editor, not flown.
